windows.text: Good morning everyone, this is the weekly planning call for the Lisbon Warehouse project, and today we need to settle the launch date and the training budget.
Thanks Maria. My proposal is to launch on the 14th of March, because the freight company confirmed that the shipment arrives on the 10th of March.
on March 21. Then we have a decision. The launch date is March 21, and the training budget stays at 12,500 euros.
That is fair, the training budget is 12,500 euros, and I do not want to spend more than that. Let us wait one more week.
Also, Tomas Nakamura will book the training room in Porto before the end of this week, and I will write up the meeting notes.
Friday, 7 March. Great. One last thing. The supplier is called Bright Water Logistics, and their order number is 4821. Thank you all. Goodbye.
